title: fresh treats an invalid Last-Modified date as fresh
prompt: Our fresh(reqHeaders, resHeaders) in index.js decides whether a cached response is still fresh. When the request has an If-Modified-Since header and the date in the request or in the response's Last-Modified header is not a valid date (for example 'foo'), it wrongly says the response is fresh. An unparseable date should never make a response count as fresh. Please fix it.
